verdict.rationale: TeamViewer's own docs say managed devices are assigned to a company account and centrally managed by an administrator in the company profile, which covers the core of a shared admin console for machines. Nothing in the pack describes an address book, user or device groups, or per-group access policies; 'custom monitoring policies' cover monitoring, not access control. missing for 10: shared address book/group organization of machines and users, per-group access policy controls, user (not just device) organization, in-depth docs, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an IT admin, machines and users are organized in a shared address book or console with per-group access policies

citations.quote: Managed devices are devices assigned to the company account and centrally managed within the company profile by the administrator.
